worlds.name: Type / Motion
worlds.composition: Two-column ledger (1.1fr / 1fr), 5vw gap; sticky preview at 65px with 105px top offset. Text rows select preview on pointer or focus and link to detail.
worlds.mobile: Preview precedes ledger in a vertical flow; preview becomes static; 20px page inset.

worlds.name: Photo Library
worlds.composition: Persistent 215px library sidebar, four-column image grid, 25px / 12px gaps; category buttons and project/client search intersect.
worlds.mobile: Sidebar becomes wrapping filter controls; two-column grid, 20px / 10px gaps. At 1000px: 175px sidebar, three columns; at 1550px: five columns.

worlds.name: Concrete
worlds.composition: Six-column irregular wall with 3px black gutters; blocks span two, three or four columns. Oversized uppercase identity and project labels supply mass.
worlds.mobile: Two columns; selected large blocks span both; 170px / 230px image heights. Identity moves above navigation.

worlds.name: Open Field
worlds.composition: Scrollable 2400px by 1830px spatial canvas; 260px and 310px tiles with small alternating rotations. Drag, zoom and reset controls sit in a fixed translucent footer.
worlds.mobile: Canvas starts at 0.7 zoom; footer wraps. Spatial navigation retains its independent complete project list.

worlds.name: Film Room
worlds.composition: Horizontal snap strip with 47vw articles, 32px gaps and 48vh contained media; caption rail supplies position, title and year. Arrow buttons scroll the strip.
worlds.mobile: 80vw articles, 18px gaps and 43vh media; footer wraps, maintaining horizontal browsing.

worlds.name: Concertina
worlds.composition: Single column of native disclosure rows; title/year/plus arrangement. Expanded body splits 1.6fr / 1fr with 5vw gap, containing image and factual metadata.
worlds.mobile: 25px titles; year removed from summary; expanded image and metadata stack with 20px gap.

worlds.name: Public Display
worlds.composition: Sticky red identity spine occupying 24%; three-column ruled exhibition wall with 35px / 15px gaps.
worlds.mobile: Identity becomes a static two-column block; two-column wall. At 1000px spine is 23%, wall already has two columns.

worlds.name: Orbit
worlds.composition: 640px scene, 1050px perspective, ten covers rotated in 36-degree steps around a 380px radius; controls rotate ring. Complete five-column project index follows.
worlds.mobile: 500px scene; perspective scaled to .67 and radius becomes 300px; complete two-column index remains.

worlds.name: Desktop
worlds.composition: Centered image window at min(760px,74vw), caption and sequence controls; fixed horizontally scrolling thumbnail dock. Active selection updates title, stage and dock state.
worlds.mobile: Window becomes 92vw with 1.35 preview ratio; dock thumbnails shrink from 48px to 42px.

worlds.name: Waterfall
worlds.composition: Three image streams with starting offsets 60px, 200px, 110px and 80px between projects; fixed vertical identity at left. Alternate images use portrait ratio.
worlds.mobile: Identity becomes horizontal; first two streams remain paired, third wraps into a full-width two-column stream.

worlds.name: Word Space
worlds.composition: Wrapping field of irregularly scaled title links with 40px / 5vw gaps. Hover or focus reveals an angled image behind each name.
worlds.mobile: Titles use 19px to 43px sizes; image reveals shrink to 160px by 110px; field clips overflowing reveals.

worlds.name: Proof Sheet
worlds.composition: Six-column photographic overview, 32px / 16px gaps, contained 1.25-ratio images; compact numbered and dated captions. No oversized hero.
worlds.mobile: Three columns with 25px / 9px gaps; at 1000px four columns and at 1550px seven columns.

worlds.name: Card Stack
worlds.composition: 30% title area beside a 400px-high layered deck, max width 650px. Three cards show depth; arrows or horizontal swipes advance the current project.
worlds.mobile: Title and deck stack; deck height becomes 320px with 26px horizontal page inset.

worlds.name: Chronology
worlds.composition: Horizontal year columns, newest first; each 285px column has a left rule, sticky year heading and vertical work sequence.
worlds.mobile: 245px columns maintain native horizontal exploration; year headings become 55px.

worlds.name: Radial
worlds.composition: 580px circular selector holds numbered 36px buttons around a centered 360px preview; adjacent title, sequence controls and direct list.
worlds.mobile: 350px wheel with 28px buttons, 230px preview; controls wrap below. At 1000px composition already stacks vertically.

worlds.name: Three Channels
worlds.composition: Three equal discipline columns with independent vertical scrolling within a viewport-height frame; Motion, Graphic and 3D headers. Projects may appear in multiple matching channels.
worlds.mobile: Channels stack; each becomes an independent horizontal snap strip with 70vw tiles.

worlds.name: Type Poster
worlds.composition: Uppercase project title bands with 2px rules and alternating 0 / 8vw / 16vw indents; hover or focus reveals an angled image.
worlds.mobile: 35px titles with 0 / 5vw / 9vw indents; reveal images shrink to 180px by 120px.

worlds.name: Collections
worlds.composition: Centered 960px collection area; three featured images above category disclosure folders. Each folder expands its own three-column project grid.
worlds.mobile: Featured row remains three images; folder contents become two columns. This is disclosure browsing, unlike route 02 filtering.

worlds.name: Oblique
worlds.composition: Anchored 30%-wide title beside a two-column image runway rotated -9 degrees; alternate projects offset 140px.
worlds.mobile: Title becomes static; runway occupies 86%, rotates -6 degrees and offsets alternating projects 90px.

worlds.name: Intervals
worlds.composition: Twelve-column asymmetric placement repeats six pair positions with 100px / 25px gaps and staggered 0 to 160px vertical offsets. Contained original-color artwork leads.
worlds.mobile: Six-column grid alternates spans 1/5 and 3/7; vertical offsets reset, 45px / 15px gaps retain the asymmetric rhythm.

narrative.northStar: Twenty independent ways into the same work
narrative.overview:
This is a source-derived record of the twenty code-led portfolio alternatives in `src/batch-three`, routes `/batch-three/01/` through `/batch-three/20/`. It applies only to this experiment. It does not redefine the production portfolio, earlier batches, or a universal 3seater identity. The comparison hub is a navigation surface, not a twenty-first design authority.

The approved brief spans minimal studios, abstract and brutalist structures, Framer-like component craft, and iOS material. Each route makes an independent choice about composition and interaction. The Design Futurist informed asset/component mechanisms only; its homepage is not a visual reference. These are original coded interpretations, not imported native Framer components.
keyCharacteristics: Independent browsing models with route-local palettes, type and form.
Original-color project media and factual metadata remain the content authority.
Spatial, sequential, textual and quiet photographic approaches coexist.

rules.name: The Route Boundary Rule
rules.body: Apply each `wNN` token only within that numbered world. Similar neutral grounds do not imply shared composition or interchangeable components.

rules.name: The Artwork Color Rule
rules.body: Preserve original project colors. UI palette choices do not authorize recoloring or desaturating media. The existing shared tile hover brightens images slightly; this is a transient state, not asset recoloring.

rules.name: The Independent Composition Rule
rules.body: Preserve the browsing mechanism and spatial structure of each world. Sharing project data, SVG icons and factual detail rendering does not establish a shared homepage shell.

dos: Do keep each world’s composition, type, colors and browsing behavior together.
Do preserve all real projects, original-color media and factual information.
Do retain direct project access, keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do treat this as a batch-three implementation snapshot while review continues.
donts: Don't impose one visual header, card shell or global palette on all twenty routes.
Don't use paper effects, crumpling or unfolding concepts.
Don't derive homepage art direction from The Design Futurist; only its assets/components were reference signals.
Don't promote batch-three decisions into production or historical batches without an explicit brief.

narrative.overview:
Batch four develops the user-selected Type Poster world, with Concrete as its secondary reference. Heavy condensed lettering supplies structure; moving artwork participates in the composition from the first viewport. The twenty routes share this voice while varying their browsing model, density, alignment and media scale.

This source-derived record applies only to `src/batch-four` and `/batch-four/01/` through `/batch-four/20/`. It is not a production-wide identity. The build is code-led; no generated comp is an authority. The comparison gallery is navigation, not an additional direction.
keyCharacteristics: Anton display typography paired with Archivo utility text.
Route-local acid, concrete, paper, red and charcoal palettes.
Flat ruled surfaces and borderless moving artwork.
Twenty distinct compositions within the selected typographic realm.

rules.name: The Route Boundary Rule
rules.body: Keep each numbered palette inside its own route; artwork retains its original color.

rules.name: The Type Structure Rule
rules.body: Preserve meaningful title hierarchy and full project-name access when adapting the layout; do not substitute a generic hero for the work.

rules.name: The Whole Artwork Rule
rules.body: Full-project artwork keeps its intrinsic proportions without opaque letterbox wrappers.

dos: Do keep the selected Anton display voice and original artwork colors.
Do preserve route-local composition when extending a direction.
Do keep complete project media at natural aspect ratio with transparent surroundings.
Do default videos to muted inline autoplay and loop, while retaining visitor playback controls.
donts: Don't add black media mats or side bars around full project artwork.
Don't make hover the requirement for video playback.
Don't treat the palette of one route as a global production brand.
Don't equate a source scan with a completed browser, accessibility or playback review.
